full_text: Enemies hit by your Hatred spenders are Slowed by {slow_pct} for {slow_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 10. | "The first three were dead before they hit the ground. The others weren't so lucky." —Captain Rumford

Whenever you use Vault, Shadow Power, Smoke Screen, or backflip with Evasive Fire you gain {movement_speed_pct} movement speed for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 10. | Never start a fair fight.

Your maximum Hatred is increased by {max_pool_resource}. In addition, gain {gain_resource:hatred} Hatred and {gain_resource:discipline} Discipline when you are healed by a health globe. | Unlocked at level 13. | "If it bleeds you can kill it. Kill this one slowly." —Greyscarr, Veteran Demon Hunter

As long as there are no enemies within {radius_yards} yards, all damage is increased by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 16. | "Flee if you can, demon. I have a quiver full of friends who fly faster than you." —Tyla Shrikewing
Increase damage against Slowed or Chilled enemies by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 20. | "I'll show you the same mercy you showed my helpless family." —Tyla Shrikewing

Your primary skills generate an additional {generated_resource} Hatred. | Unlocked at level 20. | "How did I learn to hate, to kill, to flay the flesh from the bones of my prey without pity? You taught me." —Tyla Shrikewing's final words to Naragh the Sin Eater

Gain {life_regen_pct} Life regeneration per second for every second you remain stationary, stacking up to {max_stacks_count} times. This bonus is reset {duration_seconds} seconds after you move. | Unlocked at level 25. | Never forget where you came from.

Increase movement speed by {movement_speed_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds when you hit an enemy. | Unlocked at level 27. | "Don't make me chase you back to Hell, vermin. I know a quicker way to send you there." —Tyla Shrikewing

Gain a bonus based on your weapon type: | Bow: {damage_bonus_pct} increased damage | Crossbow: {crit_damage_pct} Critical Hit Damage | Hand Crossbow: {crit_chance_pct} Critical Hit Chance | 2nd Hand Crossbow: {regen_per_second_resource} Hatred per Second | Unlocked at level 30. | "Feel the weight of the crossbow in your hand. Now... the wind, the distance, the target's speed. Good. Now try it with blood in your eyes and a demon at your throat." —Greyscarr, Veteran Demon Hunter

Enemies you Slow, Chill, or hit with Fan of Knives, Spike Trap, Caltrops, Grenades, and Sentry fire have their damage reduced by {enemy_damage_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 30. | "Demonic anatomy is strange and diverse. At times they defy sanity, but in other ways they are just as vulnerable as we are." —Meditations on the Enemy

Reduce the Discipline cost of all skills by {cost_reduction_pct}. Increase your Armor and resistance to all damage types by {resistance_pct}. | Discipline is used to fuel many of your tactical and defensive skills. | Unlocked at level 35. | Once the trap is sprung you must not relent until every last enemy has fallen. To hesitate is to invite disaster.

Increase the duration of your Caltrops, Marked for Death, Spike Trap, and Sentry by {duration_bonus_pct}. | Increase the maximum number and charges of Sentries to {max_count:sentry} and number of Spike Traps to {max_count:spike_trap}. | Unlocked at level 40. | The self-loading mechanisms built into most hand crossbows and traps are delicate and difficult to maintain. Extensive practice is required to use them properly.

Increase the damage of grenades by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Increase the explosion size of grenades by {radius_bonus_pct}. | Upon death, you drop a giant grenade that explodes for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. | Unlocked at level 45. | "Do not construct these devices by candlelight, nor by firelight. Once armed, be no closer than ten paces upon the count of three." —Explicit instructions from Quang the Chemist

Gain {crit_chance_pct} Critical Hit Chance every second. This bonus is reset {duration_seconds} second after you successfully critically hit. | Unlocked at level 50. | "Every creature has a vulnerability. Find it, and put an arrow in it." —Greyscarr, Veteran Demon Hunter

Increase damage of rockets by {damage_bonus_pct}. | In addition, you have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to fire a homing rocket for {damage_pct} weapon damage when you attack. | Unlocked at level 55. | "How should I know who first invented these devices? Just make sure the correct end is pointed at the enemy and they'll do the rest." —Greyscarr, Veteran Demon Hunter

You deal {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage to enemies above {life_threshold_pct} health. | Unlocked at level 64. | "The art of surprise is difficult, but rewarding to master." —Mynton, Demon Hunter

When you receive fatal damage, you instead vanish for {duration_seconds} seconds and regenerate {heal_pct} of maximum Life. | This effect may occur once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 66. | "Everything is a test. Study your surroundings well, and you will pass." —Josen, Master Hunter
Gain {crit_chance_pct} Critical Hit Chance against enemies who are more than {radius_yards} yards away from any other enemies. | Unlocked at level 68. | Wield your focus like a weapon.

Gain {heal_per_hit_life} Life per Hit. | Heal amount is increased by {life_per_kill_share_pct} of your Life per Kill. | Unlocked at level 60. | "For a Demon Hunter, killing is life. Kill, grow strong, and survive." –Mynton, Demon Hunter
